request.description: giant cellar rat monster, mangy dark grey-brown fur with lighter belly, long bare pink-grey tail, sharp yellow teeth, beady dark eyes, clawed feet, hunched aggressive pose, high top-down RPG monster, strong dark outline, detailed shading, muted gritty colours

walk.animation_description: rat scurrying forward on all four legs, tail swaying

attack.animation_description: rat lunging forward and biting, then pulling back

hit.animation_description: rat flinching backwards from a hard hit, then steadying

death.animation_description: rat collapsing onto its side and lying dead and still on the floor
